text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Tajmiste, a closed mine near town of Kicevo, has become successful centre for health food production. Government invested 750,000 German marks in project. U.S. experts and nutritionists to visit centre in February.
- Tragic car accident on Tetovo highway - a bus crashed into a van killing one person and injuring 14.

- Process of reorganisation of health policy and social security to start soon. World Bank to be included in reform projects. Some reforms include reduction of number of medical students and application of same rules for private and public health organisations.
